rag.text:
Test: TC-1971 — Global - Task configuration - Validation error of partial fields mapping for Jira project
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-117 Global - Task configuration
Labels: teamlego

Steps:
1. Navigate to App Settings -> General (App configuration section)
   Expected: Field mapping page is displayed
2. In "General mapping" settings set newValue1 for *Start date* field
   Data: newValue1: Original Estimate
   Expected: *Start date* field has new value - "*Original estimate*"

New *One-way sync start date field* field appears beLow Start date field.
3. Click *Save* and *refresh the page*. 
Check if newField1 is visible in "General mapping" settings after page refresh.
   Data: newField1: One-way sync start date field
   Expected: After page refresh in "General mapping" settings new field is displayed with label: *One-way sync start date field*.
4. In "General mapping" settings set: 

* newValue3 for *One-way sync start date* field
* newValue2 for *Start date* field
   Data: newValue3: Start date

newValue2: Not Synchronized
   Expected: *Start date* field value is *"Not Synchronized"*, and 

*One-way sync start date* field should disappear as Start Date is no longer set to Original estimate
5. Click *Save*
   Expected: Red coloured info:
Failed to save configuration 
is visible next to Save button

Validation errors are displayed

* Validation Error
Partial synchronization of dates is not alLowed. Disable the synchronization of both Start and End date fields or map both fields to a date picker or date time picker type of fields.

* -Validation Error-
-Cannot set secondary mapping for field which does not have main mapping configured-
6. In "General mapping" settings set:

* newValue2 for *Start date* field
* newValue4 for *End date* field

Click *Save*
   Data: newValue2: Start date

newValue4: Not Synchronized
   Expected: Validation errors is displayed

* Validation Error
Partial synchronization of dates is not alLowed. Disable the synchronization of both Start and End date fields or map both fields to a date picker or date time picker type of fields.
7. Reset fields to default values with the button on the bottom of the page
   Expected: Values are set to default
8. In "General mapping" settings set:

* newValue5 for *Baseline start date* field
* newValue6 for *Baseline end date* field

Click *Save*
   Data: newValue5: Baseline start date (customfield_xxxx): Baseline start date field used by SoftwarePlant plugins

newValue6: Not Synchronized
   Expected: Validation errors is displayed

* Validation Error
Partial synchronization of baseline dates is not alLowed. Disable the synchronization of both baseline Start and End date fields or map both fields to a date picker or date time picker type of fields.
9. In "General mapping" settings set:

* newValue5 for *Baseline start date* field
* newValue6 for *Baseline end date* field

Click *Save*
   Data: newValue5: Not Synchronized

newValue6: Baseline end date (customfield_xxxx): Baseline end date field used by SoftwarePlant plugins
   Expected: Validation errors is displayed

* Validation Error
Partial synchronization of baseline dates is not alLowed. Disable the synchronization of both baseline Start and End date fields or map both fields to a date picker or date time picker type of fields.
